## Parent

- #1

## What to build

Integrate and certify the complete Foundation Release contract, its Stable Migration Facade, platform profiles, hostile-input behavior, generated inventories, supply-chain evidence, and Central-ready release candidate.

Follow every contract and non-goal in #1. This slice is complete only when its public behavior, implementation, documentation, inventories, and evidence land together.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every capability promised by Foundation 0.1.0 is compatible with complete evidence and every required platform profile passes.
- [ ] Stable Facade and generated documentation contain exactly the Foundation-compatible mappings and no preview-only surface.
- [ ] A reproducible signed 0.1.0 release candidate and Central validation bundle are produced, but immutable publication requires separate human approval.
- [ ] Tests assert externally observable behavior at the highest available seam and do not couple to backend internals.
- [ ] Applicable Capability Matrix, Facade Surface, documentation, provenance, and Acceptance Evidence are updated; no unsupported stable stub is introduced.

## Blocked by

- #5 — [T04] Package Stable and Experimental Migration Facades
- #9 — [T08] Rehearse the secure Maven Central supply chain
- #11 — [T10] Manipulate page trees, merge, and split documents
- #12 — [T11] Manage metadata, outlines, destinations, and attachments
- #13 — [T12] Manage annotations and document actions
- #14 — [T13] Extract text and logical structure
- #15 — [T14] Extract images and document resources
- #16 — [T15] Add incremental publication and signature protection
- #17 — [T16] Implement PDF versions and password security
- #23 — [T22] Recover Worker failures and certify bounded scale
- #24 — [T23] Render bounded page images
- #26 — [T25] Complete advanced paragraph pagination
- #28 — [T27] Paginate and stream large tables
- #30 — [T29] Shape complex scripts through HarfBuzz
- #31 — [T30] Generate all Reference Suite 1D barcodes
- #32 — [T31] Generate all Reference Suite 2D barcodes
